_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Phase-In Plan
summary: Describes the transfer of and full assumption of duties at each site from the predecessor contractor during contract phase-in.
use_relationship:
The Phase-In Plan provides a detailed description of the transfer of and full assumption of duties at each site from the predecessor contractor.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the Statement of Work (SOW).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: A written comprehensive plan explaining actions
children.content: A written comprehensive plan explaining actions required to complete the total transition effort within sixty (60)-calendar day transition period, to include phase-in matters associated with the transfer to enable the Contractor's personnel to perform contract requirements.

children.title: Details of accounts and subscription services
children.content: Details of accounts and subscription services to be transferred in the transition.

children.title: Process to conduct a full joint inventory
children.content: Process to conduct a full joint inventory and transfer of all Government-owned property/inventory and all property in the pipeline until delivered, including all records.

children.title: Status of all items in inventory
children.content: Status of all items in inventory, as well as the items that have been inducted into repair facilities, are being modified, or are being purchased.

children.title: Schedule, to include critical path, for risk
children.content: Schedule, to include critical path, for risk mitigation throughout the transition period.

children.title: Impact on the mission if this data is not acquired (be specific)
Delivery and completion of the efforts described
children.content: Delivery and completion of the efforts described in the Phase-In Plan is imperative to transferring responsibilities from the incumbent to the new CLS provider. A lapse in CLS contract coverage could greatly impact accomplishment of the TACAMO mission, and not afford the prospective Contractor the opportunity to define tasks required to fully perform the duties described in the PWS.
